-- Final query with integer wins
WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        l.name as league_name,
        l.id as league_id,
        t.team_long_name,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_win
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        l.name as league_name,
        l.id as league_id,
        t.team_long_name,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_win
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_name,
        league_id,
        team_long_name,
        CAST(SUM(is_win) AS INTEGER) as total_wins
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY league_name, league_id, team_long_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        league_name,
        team_long_name,
        total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league_name ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team_long_name ASC) as rn
    FROM team_wins
)
SELECT league_name, team_long_name, total_wins
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league_name
